main_text.p: id præstat omne. Habetis quæ sit causa efficiens principalis, tantæ rei.

1. Eos autem iungit Deus, quos ab æterno elegit, & benedictione sua dignatur. Eph.1.3.4. Habetis subiectum, seu vocatos: de quibus idem Apostolus: An Iudæorum Deus solùm? annón & gentium? certè & gentium. Rom.3.29.
2.[?] Sic autem iungit, vt in Christo capite, vnum corpus sint, & vno regantur ac ducantur spiritu. Eph.3.6. & 4.4. 1.Cor.12.12.13. Hæc formalis causa aggregationis nostræ est.
4. Ideo autem nos vnum in Christo facit, vt cum Christo semper simus, & gloriam eius videamus. Ioan.17.24. Hic finis est.
main_text.head: QVORSVM AVTEM FACIVNT hæc omnia?
main_text.p: Primùm quidem eò, vt per fidem intelligamus & firmiter ad consolationem nostram statuamus, nos, plus quàm adamantino eiusdem spiritus nexu & vinculo, Christo capiti nostro iunctos, vnum cum eo fore in æternum. page.notes: Paragraph number before "Sic autem iungit" is read as 2 but the glyph is doubtful. "QVORSVM" begins with a decorated Q that is hard to confirm, read here as Q. "ne:ut" has a colon in the printed text that may be a printing error for a line-end mark. "Detvobis" is printed without a space; left as printed. "annón" carries an accent over the o, kept as printed. Page number 114 is printed at the top left.
